cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
I don't think this is the right place to check for retries, because it sticks with the backendmanager. I would instead have the counter in the `RetryWithDelay` method so consecutive failures of the same operation brings the house down, but as soon as the operation has completed the counter is reset for the next operation.

The general idea is that as long as there is progress we ignore past problems.

evidence.thread_resolution: carljohnsen: Makes sense; it's been implemented!
